assets.name: 碰瓷
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original square hand-painted Joker-card illustration for a theatrical deck-building game. Not a card template, not a collage.
Subject and dramatic action: an absurdly innocent-looking stout stage comedian, caught at the exact instant a large porcelain platter cracks in his hands. The performer has wide startled eyes and a conspiratorial theatrical grimace. A bright ivory porcelain platter dominates the lower center, splitting into two clearly readable halves along a dark jagged crack. Both hands plausibly support the platter from the sides. Two or three large ceramic chips, not a cloud of tiny particles. This is slapstick theatrical fraud and dark humor, without injury.
Style: exquisite collectible-card hand-painted illustration, painterly gouache/oil edges on subtle paper, sculptural warm upper-left stage light, deep jewel-tone velvet shadows, restrained brass highlights. Large simple silhouette and clear value separation. Warm plum/indigo stage curtain as a quiet background. The plate should stay unmistakable even at 64px; a large circle/crack and expressive actor, rather than tiny ornament.
Composition: one coherent chest-up performer holding the plate; square, dominant centered group with 8 percent safe margins; face above the plate, no obstruction of the eyes. Full main platter shape in frame, hands anatomically plausible, no extra limbs. Leave background visually simple. This is an actual narrative illustration, not an icon or SVG-like flat symbol.
Constraints: original fictional stage character, not a recognizable existing IP. No text, lettering, numbers, symbols indicating scores, card borders, UI, logos or watermark. No third-party game artwork, no photograph, no anime face, no many small objects, no busy patterns. Opaque square background.
agentInspection: At 64px the large ivory split platter and actor above it remain distinct.
Hands support the platter at each side; no extra limbs observed in generated and exported images.
